FAQs

Is there a booking fee?

Concierge support is complimentary for 69Shop sellers and premium buyers. Project fees are quoted transparently with GST invoices and optional escrow.

Can I bring my own vendors?

Yes! We can vet, onboard, and contract external vendors inside the 69Shop workspace so you still benefit from milestone tracking and dispute resolution.

What about international shipping?

Handmade jewellery, gifting, and bakery partners ship worldwide via insured carriers. Distribution and saree services currently operate within India.

Need help deciding the right service?

Our concierge desk can co-create proposals, negotiate pricing, align vendors, and unlock loyalty credits across jewellery, fashion, gifting, food, distribution, and photography partners.
